attchmntText: IFGL Refractories Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: IFGL Refractories Limited has published newspaper advertisements containing a QR code for accessing its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Statutory auditors have conducted a limited review of these results. The financial statements and limited review reports are available on the BSE website, NSE website, and the company website at https://ifglgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Disclosure.pdf. The announcement was signed by Managing Director Mihir Prakash Bajoria, holding DIN 09346426. The advertisements were published in Business Standard and Pratidin Odia on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: IFGL Refractories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: IFGL Refratories Limited approved Unaudited Financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026. The Board Meeting was held on 13th November, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 32,329 lakhs for the quarter and 61,987 lakhs for six months. Standalone profit before tax was 2,448 lakhs for the quarter and 4,550 lakhs for six months. Standalone profit for the period was 1,832 lakhs for the quarter and 3,410 lakhs for six months. Earnings per share were 2.54 for the quarter and 4.73 for six months. The results were reviewed by Statutory Auditors, M/s S R Batliboi & Co. LLP. An emphasis of matter notes uncertainty regarding an income tax appeal pending before the High Court at Calcutta. Consolidated results were also approved.

attchmntText: IFGL Refractories Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: IFGL Refractories Limited will hold a conference call with its management on Tuesday, 17th November, 2026, at 4 PM IST. The event is organized by Monarch Networth Capital. The agenda includes a discussion on Q2 and H1FY27 earnings updates. The company has disclosed this under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. Details are available on the company website at https://ifglgroup.com/investor/earnings-call/.
